cases.name: Straightforward refund
cases.input: Hi — my order ORD-2291 arrived with a cracked screen. I'd like a refund of $42.50 please. I don't need a replacement, I've already ordered a new one.

cases.name: No order identifier in the message
cases.input: My parcel still hasn't turned up and nobody has answered my emails. This is the third time I've written. Please sort it out.

cases.name: Delivery fee and refund in one message
cases.input: Order ORD-4410: you charged me twice. The $6.99 delivery fee was taken again, and I still haven't had the $34.99 refund you promised on the phone.

cases.name: “the usual one”
cases.input: Just refund me for the usual one, you know the order I mean. Same as last time.

cases.name: Two products, one message
cases.input: Two separate things: ORD-7712 needs a refund of $18.00 because the mug arrived chipped, and ORD-7713 should be replaced — the lamp was broken in the box.

cases.name: No amount stated, currency mentioned
cases.input: I was overcharged on ORD-5501 — the total was higher than the price shown at checkout. Please refund the difference.
